title: Interop testing against Stalwart
description:
Opt-in interop and differential testing of crate-jmap against Stalwart (real JMAP server). Not in default CI; nothing links or vendors Stalwart (AGPL), it runs only as an external test server.
Findings 2026-10-18: crate-jmap has no external-server interop today. Rootless podman 4.9.3 works (docker daemon not accessible). docker.io/stalwartlabs/stalwart:latest = v0.16 boots, but starts in bootstrap mode (temporary admin shown once, setup expected via web UI; /.well-known/jmap 307 until set up). STALWART_RECOVERY_ADMIN=admin:<password> pins a credential; unattended setup needs a config file + management API calls (to research).
